stages.title: Stack the laminations
stages.text: Core packets stacked on the mandrel, slot 1 aligned

stages.title: Weld the core
stages.text: Six weld seams along the OD notches hold the stack

stages.title: Insert slot liners and closures
stages.text: Liners with cuffs at both ends, closure strips under the tooth tips

stages.title: Insert the hairpins
stages.text: Pre-formed hairpins pushed in from the crown side, legs straight

stages.title: Expand the layers
stages.text: Leg rings spread radially to open the weld-side gaps

stages.title: Twist
stages.text: Odd and even layer rings twisted in opposite directions (half pitch each)

stages.title: Weld the tips
stages.text: Adjacent tips welded (laser or TIG); switched welds link the layer pairs

stages.title: Coat the weld heads
stages.text: Epoxy powder coating insulates the bare weld heads

stages.title: Fit jumpers and terminal bars
stages.text: Jumpers join the paths; terminal tabs or bus bars brought out

stages.title: Connect the leads
stages.text: IEC: flexible leads, ferrules, ties. EV: neutral ring and phase bus bars

stages.title: Press the stator into the frame
stages.text: Interference fit in the frame bore

stages.title: Insert the rotor
stages.text: Rotor with shaft and both 6204-2Z bearings

stages.title: Fit the end shields
stages.text: Spigots into the frame, four tie bolts

stages.title: Fan and cowl
stages.text: Fan on the NDE shaft end with circlip, cowl screwed to the shield

stages.title: Terminal box
stages.text: Leads onto studs U1 V1 W1 / W2 U2 V2, links set, lid closed
